title: every decision card on the board carries a coloured kind badge at its top left - 合併 Merge, 派工 Dispatch, 重新固定 Repin, 範圍 Scope, 技能 Skill or 決定 Decision - read from the card's recorded kind and a new optional recorded purpose, so the captain tells a dispatch card from a merge card at a glance
acceptance: Why. On 2026-10-06 the captain could not tell merge cards from dispatch cards ('合併 #212：頁面輪詢時 fm board 也能替換自己的看板 怎麼一直有重複的意圖對齊卡要我點選'): both are full intent cards with the same sections, and the only difference is the title text firstmate writes. He asked for a coloured badge ('加上色塊標籤'). Diagnosis on main 2428fee: a pending record (state/pending/<id>.json, written by bin/fm-decide.sh --request, bin/fm-decide.sh:433-439) stores `kind` (choice | merge | merge-untracked; fm-decide.sh:332 refuses any other), `title` (the en title) and `details`; it records no purpose, so a dispatch, a repin, a scope widening and any other choice card are all `kind: choice` and differ only in the title firstmate authored ('Dispatch T-…' / '派工 T-…', 'Repin T-…' / '重新固定 T-…'). Legacy skill-update cards are `D-SK-*` ids (fm-decide.sh:452-476); `fm self-update` (bin/fm.sh:717) raises `D-SK-*` cards through the details path with `--kind choice`. The board's server passes every pending field through unchanged (board/server.ts pendingIn, :1477-1535, spreads the parsed record into `card`), and T-222 shows every project's cards on the main page. The page draws the first card with `full(d)` (board/public/index.html:676-700, meta line `whose(d)` at :669-674) and every other card as a `details.dstrip` whose summary is `whose(d)` plus the title (:712-720). No badge exists today.

Change 1 - recorded purpose (bin/fm-decide.sh). `--request` accepts an optional `--purpose

` with p one of `dispatch`, `repin`, `scope`, `skill`, `decision`. It is valid only with `--kind choice` (the default); with `--kind merge` or `merge-untracked` it exits 64 with `fm-decide: --purpose applies only to a choice card`; any other value exits 64 with `fm-decide: bad purpose

`. The value-taking flag uses the existing `need` guard (fm-decide.sh:53, :80-93) like every other flag, and the usage line (:97) and header comment (:4-9) name it. When given, the details-path payload (:433-439) gains `purpose:$purpose`; when omitted no `purpose` key is written, so every existing card and caller is byte-for-byte unchanged. The legacy title-only `D-SK-*` path (:452-476) refuses `--purpose`: at the top of that branch, before any title check or file write, a non-empty purpose exits 64 with `fm-decide: --purpose requires --details` and writes no pending file. Nothing else in fm-decide.sh changes; `--allocate`, `--await`, the merge binding and the diagram call are untouched.

Change 2 - callers. bin/fm.sh's self-update request (:717) passes `--purpose skill`. bin/lib/fm_autopilot_loop.py:430 raises merge cards and passes nothing (kind merge already says merge); it is listed as unchanged. skills/firstmate/SKILL.md's choice-request example (:868-873) shows `--purpose dispatch` and one sentence lists the five purposes and says firstmate passes the matching one on every choice card it raises (dispatch for a dispatch/readiness card, repin for a repin approval, scope for a scope widening, skill for a skill update, decision otherwise). No other script in bin/ calls `fm-decide.sh --request` (grep of bin/, bin/lib/, skills/ and board/ on 2428fee finds only these three).

Change 3 - the badge (board/public/index.html only; board/server.ts unchanged because pendingIn already passes `purpose` through). One function `cardKind(d)` decides the badge, in this order: `d.kind` is `merge` or `merge-untracked` -> merge; `d.purpose` is one of the five values -> that value; `d.id` is a `D-SK-*` skill id -> skill; otherwise the old-card fallback reads the authored titles: en title starting `Dispatch ` or zh-TW title starting `派工` -> dispatch, `Repin ` / `重新固定` -> repin, `Scope` / `範圍` -> scope, `Skill update` / `技能` -> skill; anything else -> decision. A badge `label` is the first element of the full card's meta line (before `whose(d)`) and of every strip's summary, so it sits at the top left of every decision card in the deck, for every project's card on the main page. Labels come from new i18n keys `kindMerge`, `kindDispatch`, `kindRepin`, `kindScope`, `kindSkill`, `kindDecision` in i18n/ui.en.json ('Merge', 'Dispatch', 'Repin', 'Scope', 'Skill', 'Decision') and i18n/ui.zh-TW.json ('合併', '派工', '重新固定', '範圍', '技能', '決定'); zh-CN follows through the existing tw2cn conversion. Colours are six new CSS custom properties on :root (`--k-merge`, `--k-dispatch`, `--k-repin`, `--k-scope`, `--k-skill`, `--k-decision`) used as the badge background, with merge and dispatch clearly different hues (merge a green family like --ok, dispatch a blue family like --accent); badge text colour is chosen per token so text-to-fill contrast is at least 4.5:1 for every kind. The board has one (dark) theme today; there is no light theme to cover, and this task adds none. Badge font is bold, at least 12px, with padding so the fill reads as a block; it never wraps and never shrinks the meta line's other content below what it shows today.

Tests (fail-first: bin/fm-failfirst.sh runs only `*.test.sh`, so the red-on-base assertions are bash): (a) tests/decide.test.sh, in the existing fixture: `--request <id> --task T-… --details <file> --purpose dispatch` exits 0 and the pending record has `.purpose == "dispatch"`; a request without `--purpose` writes no `purpose` key; `--purpose bogus` exits 64 naming the value; `--kind merge … --purpose dispatch` exits 64 (before any GitHub read); `--purpose` with no value exits 64 through the `need` guard. `--request D-SK-00x --task SK-00x --title t --purpose skill` (the legacy title-only path) exits 64 with `fm-decide: --purpose requires --details` and leaves no pending file, alongside the existing legacy refusals at tests/decide.test.sh:100-128. On base fm-decide.sh rejects `--purpose` as an unknown argument, so the success assertion is red. (b) tests/option-loop.test.sh: the pinned list (:50) becomes `fm-decide 12` and the pinned total at :158 becomes 121 (from 120), so the new flag is exercised by the same value-guard loop. (c) a bash assertion that bin/fm.sh's self-update call passes `--purpose skill` in tests/selfupdate.test.sh, which drives `fm self-update`: the pending `D-SK-*` record it writes has `.purpose == "skill"`. (d) e2e: tests/e2e/board-decisions.spec.ts gains one case with four pending cards in the fixture (a merge card, a choice card with `purpose: dispatch`, an old choice card without purpose titled `Repin T-…`, and a plain choice card): the first full card and each strip show exactly one `.kbadge` as the first element of the meta/summary, with the class and localized text of its kind (merge / dispatch / repin / decision), in English and after switching to 繁體中文; computed background colours of the merge and dispatch badges differ; and for every badge the WCAG contrast of computed text colour against computed background is at least 4.5. Existing e2e and bash suites that snapshot the meta line or strip summary text (grep tests/e2e and tests/*.sh for `whose`, `.dstrip summary`, `.meta` text assertions) are updated in place only where the badge text now appears; list each in the PR.

Design and docs. design/design.md: §5.2 'Captain decisions' (heading :249): its 'Two kinds.' paragraph (:260) gains, in place, one sentence: a choice card may record a purpose (dispatch, repin, scope, skill, decision) with `--purpose`, and the board shows every card's kind and purpose as a coloured badge, falling back to the title for cards raised before T-227. Section 8's table row 'Decision deck' gains, in place, 'each card and strip starts with a coloured kind badge (T-227)'. No new section is appended to the end of design.md (T-189). skills/firstmate/SKILL.md as in Change 2.

Migration and in-flight cards. Pending cards already on disk have no `purpose`; the title fallback in Change 3 badges them (firstmate's dispatch, repin and merge titles already start with the words the fallback reads), and any card the fallback cannot classify shows 'Decision', never nothing. No stored record is rewritten. Cards answered before the board reloads keep working; the badge is display only and changes no answer, effect or binding.

Out of scope: lane cards, the roster, the live log, the voyage panel, board/server.ts, fm-autopilot, fm-merge, any change to how a card is answered, and a light theme. Scope: bin/fm-decide.sh, bin/fm.sh, board/public/index.html, i18n/ui.en.json, i18n/ui.zh-TW.json, skills/firstmate/SKILL.md, tests/**, design/design.md, design/tasks/T-227.json. Any other file needing a change: stop and name it.
